_provenance.sigver_derivation: sigVer entries below are NOT drawn from NIST's separate SLH-DSA-sigVer-FIPS205 test set. Each is the corresponding sigGen entry's own (pk, message, context, signature) — a genuine NIST-generated signature that must verify by construction. This was a deliberate choice to avoid a second ~30MB+70MB download for this pass; every byte is still 100% NIST-sourced, only the ACVP *operation* label differs from what a sigVer-set-sourced entry would say. A dedicated SLH-DSA-sigVer-FIPS205 pull (which also carries deliberately-invalid testPassed=false cases, useful adversarial coverage) remains a worthwhile follow-up, not done here.
_provenance.note: Replaces a prior file covering only SLH-DSA-SHA2-128f (1 of 12 parameter sets), itself untraceable to any real NIST sample case (2026-08-24 WS-6 remediation, H-4 — the plan's 'sharpest case': 11 of 12 parameter sets previously had no external vector at all, only self-consistency round-trips in HsmAcvpTesting.tsx section 9). Now covers all 12.
